name: UCAS Tariff Points Calculator
tagline: Turn your A Level grades into UCAS tariff points in seconds.
title: UCAS Tariff Points Calculator for A Levels (Free)
h1: UCAS tariff points calculator for A Levels
description: Free UCAS tariff points calculator. Add your A Level grades from A* to E to get your total points, with each grade's value shown.
card_summary: Add your A Level grades to get your total UCAS tariff points, with each grade's value shown.
lead: Choose a grade for each A Level subject and the calculator adds up your UCAS tariff points as you change them. Each grade has a fixed value, so you can see exactly where your total comes from.
takeaways: Each A Level grade is worth a fixed number of points, from 56 for an A* down to 16 for an E.
AAA totals 144 points, and AAB totals 136.
IB and BTEC points come from separate tables, so add those yourself.
Many courses ask for specific grades, so check each course's entry requirements.

sections.h2: How are UCAS tariff points calculated?
sections.html: UCAS tariff points add up the points from each qualification on your application, so universities can compare A Levels, IB and BTEC on one scale. For A Levels, every grade has a fixed number of points, and your total is the sum across your subjects. The official tables are published by UCAS in its tariff tables.

sections.h2: What is each A Level grade worth?
sections.html:
GradeUCAS points
A*56
A48
B40
C32
D24
E16

A Level points run from 56 for an A* down to 16 for an E. Three A grades add up to 144, which is the figure people usually mean when they say AAA.

sections.h2: What about IB, BTEC and other qualifications?
sections.html: This calculator covers A Levels only. IB and BTEC use their own tables, so look up those points and add them to your total yourself. A BTEC is sized like a set of A Levels, and Pearson explains the conversion on its BTEC UCAS points page.

sections.h2: Do universities always ask for points?
sections.html: Not always. Many courses list specific grades, such as AAB, so points are a useful way to compare offers rather than a guarantee. Which? University shows how predicted grades turn into points. Check each course page for its exact entry requirements.

faq.a: UCAS tariff points are a single number that turns your Level 3 grades into a score that universities can compare, whatever qualification you took.

faq.q: How many UCAS points is AAA?
faq.a: AAA is 144 points, because an A is worth 48 points at A Level.

faq.q: Does this calculator include IB or BTEC?
faq.a: Not yet. It covers A Levels only. For IB or BTEC, find the points in the official tables and add them to your total.
